parsedVerdict.reasoning: The layer model assigns **/*.module.ts files to the presentation layer. That means NestJS module files are treated as framework-level composition roots. This file only does module wiring. It registers the controller, binds ports to adapters through DI providers, builds the interactors with factory providers, and registers the ORM entities with TypeOrmModule.forFeature. None of this is business logic. There are no business rules, no persistence queries or data mapping, and no transport handling. TypeOrmModule.forFeature is a declarative registration, not persistence logic, and it is the expected job of a NestJS module. No ADR prose was given that would contradict this. Whether the module may import infrastructure and domain files is an import-direction question, which is out of scope here.
